verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a documented API tokens feature, and a community user reports an app password restricted to SMTP only, which is a product-native least-privilege credential. The evidence pack only contains the API tokens page title, so the token scopes themselves are undocumented here. missing for 10: documented per-token scope options for JMAP/API access (e.g., read-only mail, specific capabilities), revocation/expiry details, first-party docs content beyond a page title, and corroboration of agent-oriented scoped token issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Uses Fastmail SMTP for transactional emails with an app password that can only access SMTP.
